message: Created commit-template.md with full emoji change-type table (11 rows), format block, and rules list. File located at packages/chronicle/skills/commit/references/commit-template.md. Verified: all content present, no odin references, table complete. Ready for consume by analyze fork.

Codex successfully implemented request-creator.ts and request-creator.test.ts: buildArgs pure function handles both github and gitlab argument generation (with draft flag support), createRequest async function with injectable runner handles CLI spawning, URL extraction from stdout, and proper error mapping (missing-cli, no-remote, cli-error). All 7 unit tests pass. CLI mode reads JSON from stdin and returns structured result without throwing. Verified via bun test (7/7 pass) and smoke test (CLI returns proper error handling).

codex successfully implemented analyze-branch.ts with all three pure functions (detectProvider, projectMatches, branchDecisions), full test coverage (12 tests passing), git gathering with --base override, soft cockpit harvest with dedup and time-filtering, and proper CLI output with temp file writing. Verified: tests pass, script runs on real branch with github detection, provider detection works for ssh/https/self-hosted gitlab, and cockpit absence gracefully degrades to hasCockpit:false.

Codex created packages/chronicle/skills/commit/references/commit-template.md with full format block (emoji + type + subject), complete 11-row change-type table (feat/fix/docs/style/refactor/test/chore/remove/hotfix/security/perf), and 5 rules covering subject length, body+summary requirements, trivial exceptions, separator, and staging. File verified: exists at correct path, zero odin references, table complete.

Codex successfully ported analyze-changes.ts with all four pure functions (parseStatusLine, unquoteGitPath, shouldSkipDiff, isBinaryFile), comprehensive unit tests (14 tests passing), correct template resolution to chronicle's own ../references/commit-template.md with ~-expansion support, temp output at /tmp/chronicle/commit/ as specified, and zero odin/atomic-commit references. CLI runs correctly printing three-key JSON with outputPath, promptPath, totalFiles. All acceptance criteria met.

Codex successfully implemented SKILL.md with valid frontmatter (name: pr, trigger phrases, human-invoked only), two-phase fork flow (analyze → gate → create), 4-section body structure (Why/What changed/What to focus on/How to judge) with cockpit field mappings, soft cockpit dependency handling, unknown-provider stop condition, interactive gate with create/draft/edit/abort options via AskUserQuestion, and correct script resolution using SKILL_DIR with file-exists guards. All acceptance criteria verified: no odin-git references, no sibling-task-id references, proper error handling documented. File created at packages/chronicle/skills/pr/SKILL.md.

Codex successfully created SKILL.md with complete two-phase fork orchestration (analyze → gate → write). File documents staging model, decision tree (≥2 change-types, cross-module, >5 files), phase gates, CommitPlan structure, atomic-split confirmation via AskUserQuestion/host, and template format (emoji + body + 繁中). All acceptance criteria verified: proper frontmatter, no odin references, no task-id leaks, edge cases addressed.

Codex created 3/4 files (.claude-plugin/plugin.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json) due to sandbox permission limit on .agents registry write; dev completed the 4th file (.agents/plugins/marketplace.json) manually. All four JSON files parse cleanly; both registries contain exactly one chronicle entry with no version field; existing monitor/dispatch/relay entries untouched. Verification: ✓ all parses, ✓ 1 chronicle entry each registry, ✓ no version in registry entries, ✓ existing entries preserved.

Codex successfully implemented changelog and CLAUDE.md documentation: added chronicle 0.1.0 entry to CHANGELOG.md with Keep a Changelog format (Added subsection), updated CLAUDE.md 'What This Is' from three to four plugins with chronicle bullet, added packages/chronicle/ architecture block with both manifests and skills listed, and updated Releasing section to enumerate chronicle's independent versioning alongside relay. All edits are additive/surgical. Commit: 71d31c5.

All 5 lenses fired (codex, reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude); ~13 findings total. Cross-vendor (codex) lens RAN and passed (33 tests, no bugs); its only note was that chronicle's plugin.json manifests are untracked — expected pre-commit, files exist on disk, will be git-added with the rest of the plan (no working-tree fix). Applied behaviour-preserving chronicle cleanups: hoisted SKIP_DIFF_PATTERNS + BINARY_EXTENSIONS to module consts, deduped the binary-result object via binaryResult() (kept branch order so .lockb still hits the lock branch), and parallelized gatherGit's 6 independent post-mergeBase git reads via Promise.all (preserved head.trim()). Rejected: monitor daily-activity.ts/api.ts dead-param findings (files not in this plan's diff, out of scope); efficiency numstat-from-diff derivation (behaviour-changing, edge cases); concurrency-cap (speculative); request-creator preflight removal (breaks the tested missing-cli path — non-zero exit != ENOENT); reuse findings (reviewer marked all by-design/no-change for package isolation). Verification: bun test 33/33 green; both manifests parse at 0.1.0 (byte-identical); exactly one chronicle registry entry per marketplace with no version field; empty COCKPIT_HOME -> exit 0 hasCockpit:false; grep -ri odin empty; all SKILL->script paths resolve; CLAUDE.md says 'four local plugins' + tree block + independent versioning; CHANGELOG has chronicle 0.1.0; git diff --check clean; siblings untouched (a pre-existing unrelated monitor dashboard-app.js change exists, not caused by me, left as-is). v1 goal met: commit (simple/atomic auto-decision) + pr (4-section GitHub/GitLab body) shippable to both marketplaces at independent 0.1.0, zero odin-git dependency.
